They were quick to assist me in understanding my coverage and helped me navigate the hospital procedures.

The bill for my emergency treatment was around 3,000 euros, and I was relieved to find that Tata AIG covered the entire amount without any deductions. Their guidance made a significant difference, ensuring that my medical expenses were taken care of without any hassle. I had clear communication and prompt responses whenever I had questions, which eased my worries during a tough time.

I didn’t face any issues when I needed to make a claim afterward. The process was straightforward, and the customer service I received was excellent. I felt supported and reassured throughout the ordeal.

Every experience can vary, but I can confidently say my experience with Tata AIG and Hitech Solutions in Bangalore has been very positive, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable insurance."
